title: The Work Bears the Mantle: A Mantle Symbolon — the Good Gray Poet, the King of May, the Prince of Poets (EA-MANTLE-BEARING-01 v1.1)
voice: Lee Sharks; prefatory poem by Sen Kuro
author: Lee Sharks
gloss: The constitution the three mantle claims are judged under: one half of a symbolon, cut so that its other half can be supplied only by a reading of the works
description: The Work Bears the Mantle (EA-MANTLE-BEARING-01 v1.1, #1656): the Good Gray Poet, the King of May and the Prince of Poets stated as claims, with the operations they inherit, the works they require and the reading that settles them. One half of a symbolon; it completes in traversal.
symbolon: It governs the judgment of the three mantle objects — the Good Gray Poet, the King of May, the Prince of Poets — and names the works that bear them: I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z, The Secret Book of Walt, Pearl and Other Poems. Its other half is a reading of the works, and the readings are kept in the mantle-bearing dataset.
